name: LocalFlow M06 adversarial corpus
interpretation: All cases are authored synthetic development challenges. No repository/native tests were executed by the GPT audit. No prevalence, independent-sample or held-out claims. The local remediation session must implement independent adapters/oracles and retain base/first-pass/final outcomes separately.

status_policy.policy_status: UNADJUDICATED where current contracts require a decision; not a pass or an observed failure
status_policy.provider_tokens: Existing tokens are used where established. Semantic assertions and proposed invalid/closed/revoked distinctions require documented provider-vocabulary adjudication, not silent changes to frozen envelope reasons.

coordinate_policy: Synthetic Python string cases use code points unless explicitly labeled native UTF-16. Native ranges must be boxed/unboxed and converted explicitly; grapheme clusters are distinct.
synthetic_privacy: All targets, paths, text, credentials and canaries are invented. Real application bundle IDs are classification keys only. No Daniel data is included.

metamorphic_relations.name: Privacy monotonicity
metamorphic_relations.relation: Changing a normal field to secure removes field-content reads and retained field content; allowed identity is not removed merely to satisfy the test.

metamorphic_relations.name: Deny monotonicity
metamorphic_relations.relation: Adding the captured app to the denied list removes every destination-derived AX read and value.

metamorphic_relations.name: Destination isolation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Changing B only cannot change A frozen bytes, target ID or context ID.

metamorphic_relations.name: Late-result isolation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Completion after cutoff changes only a separately identified downstream observation, never original hints or bytes.

metamorphic_relations.name: Cache invalidation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Changing a validated destination identity invalidates its metadata even when display title/role stay equal.

metamorphic_relations.name: Frozen-entry scope upgrade
metamorphic_relations.relation: Widening scope changes eligibility, not the captured entry content/revision.

metamorphic_relations.name: Independent retention
metamorphic_relations.relation: Turning context retention off changes persisted payload availability, not permitted dictation output.

metamorphic_relations.name: Representation equivalence
metamorphic_relations.relation: Allowed site casing/default-port representations compare correctly in M05 while original M06 value/provenance remains recorded.

metamorphic_relations.name: Failure honesty
metamorphic_relations.relation: Replacing provider success by a failure cannot keep resolved status or improve completeness.

metamorphic_relations.name: Measured-delay conservation
metamorphic_relations.relation: Injecting a known delay inside context release work increases the measured release boundary duration instead of disappearing before the clock.
